summary: Vistance Networks filed an 8-K on April 30, 2026, disclosing Q1 2026 financial results under Item 2.02 (furnished, not filed) and, under Item 8.01, a board-authorized share repurchase program of up to $100 million, replacing a prior $50 million authorization. Repurchases may occur in open market or privately negotiated transactions, potentially via Rule 10b-18 or Rule 10b5-1 plans. No specific price, premium, or timeline is stated. The program is discretionary and may be modified or suspended. Watch for execution pace and capital allocation priorities; the replacement of a smaller program signals increased commitment to shareholder returns.
